name: cmdb_resourcecenter_account_protocol
label: CMDB Resource Center Account Protocol Table
description: CMDB resource center account agreement table is used for time dimension statistical queries related to configuration management.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Protocol ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Protocol name. This value must be unique in the database and is suitable for exact-match queries and duplicate detection.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: uniq_name
indexes.description: Unique index covering the name field, suitable for exact-match retrieval, uniqueness checks, and duplicate detection.
